meta.title: CAD Engineer
meta.tagline: Create precise 3D models and technical documentation for manufacturing.
meta.description: CAD engineers specialize in creating detailed computer-aided design models, technical drawings and documentation. They ensure designs are accurate, manufacturable and meet industry standards.
